race.comment: MODELLA (4) is a stable star of the Curtis yard and profiles strongly after tackling deep fillies and mares races last campaign. The peaks are there and her recent trial suggests she's breathing fire. Lloyd's strong association is another push. CIGAR FLICK (3) has been far more consistent this prep despite only posting one win. She has a devastating turn of foot on her day and if she gets clear air she'll be savaging the line. JMac sticking a bonus. OH DIAMOND LIL (1) is a speedy mare resuming for Pfieffer and King will no doubt hunt the front. If she can pinch a couple of cheapies mid-race she'll be very hard to reel in. JUST GLAMOUROUS (6) is another obvious pace influence and with a fitness edge she'll be in this for a long way. MARETH (7) hit the line hard fresh in town and will relish the anticipated tempo. Watch for her launching late.
